name: Archbishop Benedictus
summary: In Stormwind City, Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light from the Cathedral of Light. He guides the faithful and the Alliance through uncertain times.

sections.title: Shepherd of the Holy Light
sections.body: Archbishop Benedictus took the Church’s leadership after his mentor, Archbishop Alonsus Faol, died. He had seen the First and Second Wars devastate the kingdoms and helped oversee the building of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. He vowed to uphold the virtues of the faith. After Lordaeron fell and the Scourge rose during the Third War, the human kingdoms looked to him for spiritual guidance. From the Cathedral, he counsels the royal court, trains newly initiated priests, and directs holy crusades against the undead and demonic forces threatening Azeroth.

sections.title: A Beacon of Hope
sections.body: Across the Alliance, people regard Archbishop Benedictus as a gentle, wise, and benevolent patriarch. He offers the public hope and rallies heroes against dark threats, including Amnennar the Coldbringer in Kalimdor. He also helps purify cursed relics brought by faithful adventurers.

aliases: leader of church of the holy light
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light and is the highest religious authority in the Grand Alliance. From the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, he guides the faithful and counsels the kingdom’s leaders.

faq.q: What is his relationship to Alonsus Faol?
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus was the foremost pupil of Archbishop Alonsus Faol, founder of the Knights of the Silver Hand. After Faol died, Benedictus took up leadership of the Church and continued his mentor’s work.

faq.q: What tasks does Benedictus oversee for adventurers?
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus directs Alliance heroes against the Scourge, including expeditions into Razorfen Downs to slay the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer. He also uses holy power to cleanse corrupted artifacts such as the Cursed Eye of Paleth.

faq.q: What is his stance on the undead?
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus calls for the Forsaken to receive a swift, permanent death. His follower Commander Karl Philips says the Archbishop asks only for their hearts to be brought back and burned at the Cathedral of Light.

angles.text: As a priest, you look to Archbishop Benedictus, who oversees the training, doctrines, and vows of all Alliance priests as head of the Church of the Holy Light.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Archbishop Benedictus for moral guidance and spiritual comfort for refugees. He also guides high-ranking paladins and commanders.
